feeds.title: Minimalist Baker
feeds.description: Sharing simple, delicious plant-based and mostly gluten-free recipes. Minimalist Baker is about celebrating simple cooking with recipes that require 10 ingredients or less, 1 bowl, or 30 minute or less to prepare.

feeds.title: Gretchens Vegan Bakery
feeds.description: This is the LAST STOP for the greatest recipes compiled over 20yrs of my baking career! Here we share our creations & passionate love of baking!

feeds.title: FRAN COSTIGAN Blog
feeds.description: Fran Costigan, the Queen of Vegan Desserts, is a culinary instructor and consultant, internationally recognized as the go-to authority on vegan pastry arts and is herself a vegan.

feeds.title: Texanerin Baking - Healthier baked goods that don't taste healthy.
feeds.description: Welcome to Texanerin Baking! My name is Erin and I'm from Texas. Baking is on my mind - all the time. Follow this blog to get more healthy baked recipes.

feeds.title: Fragrant Vanilla Cake
feeds.description: I am a vegan girl who is passionate about good food! I especially like to create healthier desserts and veggie filled dishes. I also believe that food is art and is meant to be shared!

feeds.title: Unconventional Bakers
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Audrey, the girl behind Unconventional Baker {formerly Gluten-Free Vegan Love}. I'm a baker, un-baker, blogger, photographer & food stylist, creating refined sugar-free, gluten-free, plant-fueled, often raw and always wholesome recipes I hope you enjoy this space and find something yummy to make!

feeds.title: Rainbow Nourishments
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Anthea, and welcome to Rainbow Nourishments! I love talking about food and get really excited about ice cream. I created Rainbow Nourishments in 2014 to meet like-minded people and to share my love of food. All the recipes I create for Rainbow Nourishments are vegan as I believe it's more sustainable for the world and minimizes harm to animals.

feeds.title: Vegan Richa
feeds.description: Vegan Food Blog with Healthy and Flavorful Vegan Recipes.

feeds.title: The Conscious Plant Kitchen
feeds.description: I am Carine Claudepierre, the foodie, foodwriter, food photographer and videographer at The Conscious Plant Kitchen. The easy plant-based recipes you'll find here are inspired by our family story. My husband chose to live a conscious life in 2016. He made the choice to eat plant-based food to be good for the planet and the animals.

feeds.title: Lazy Cat Kitchen
feeds.description: A food blog from sunny Greece with lots of simple, delicious, vibrant, colourful and easy plant-based recipes and cooking techniques from all over the world.

feeds.title: Rhian's Recipes
feeds.description: Easy, undetectably vegan and gluten-free recipes with lots of Japanese inspiration!

feeds.title: Beaming Baker
feeds.description: Plant-based allergy-friendly recipes made fun.

feeds.title: Addicted to Dates
feeds.description: Addicted to Dates is a vegan food blog on a mission to feed everyone delicious vegan desserts without ever compromising on taste or values.

feeds.title: Bitter Sweet
feeds.description: Bitter Sweet is a blog by Hannah Kaminsky focused on plant-based recipe development and photography with a particular penchant for baking.

feeds.title: Vegan Baking Up High
feeds.description: Baking is a large part of my life. Dessert was a given in my family, and I liked being the one to make it. As I grew older my diet changed and I started baking without dairy or eggs. Then I moved to high altitude and that added a whole new twist to things. Thus, Vegan Baking Up High was born.

feeds.title: Cooking on Caffeine
feeds.description: My name is Meggan and this is Cooking on Caffeine: a recipe and baking blog that focuses on pushing the envelope to transform all kinds of foods into vegan and allergy-friendly masterpieces that anyone can make; I'm known for breaking the rules and creating new ones to bring imagination to life no matter the dietary restrictions.

feeds.title: Sara Kidd Blog
feeds.description: Welcome baking friends! Here you will find loads of vegan baking recipes, tips and tricks and my Vegan Baking Show - Bake Vegan Stuff with Sara Kidd.

feeds.title: The Lazy Vegan Baker
feeds.description: I am an avid baker, culinary school graduate, embracer of challenges, and budding writer. Even the best of us find ourselves short on time, or motivation, so this is my foray into making awesome vegan dessert.

feeds.title: Sarah Bakes Gluten Free
feeds.description: I'm Sarah, the baker and blogger here at Sarah Bakes Gluten Free. Creating gluten, dairy and egg free recipes, that are approachable and delicious.

feeds.title: Veggie Desserts
feeds.description: I'm Kate Hackworthy, a journalist, author and award-winning food blogger. Subscribe us to keep up with Hundreds of recipes on desserts.

feeds.title: Oh, Ladycakes
feeds.description: Baking Blog by Ashley, a professional cook and recipe writer. Ashley combines her love for food with her eco-conscious mind to create Vegan recipes and dishes. Her blog articles mainly focus on Sweet Dishes, Cakes, and Cookies, Cooking Tools & Products, while also featuring her latest Holiday travels.
